sourceReview: Reviewed original and final PUT route, PostgreSQL Drizzle client, schema and real API helpers. Parent update/version increment and conditional step delete/insert now share one transaction handle. Tenant predicate, null result, omitted versus empty steps and mapping are preserved; error conversion stays outside callback.
teachingReview: Reviewed all nine chapters with source links, before/after, trace table, exercises and concrete answers. Corrected real API helper versus NextResponse adapter scope and globally unique workflow-id fixture guidance. Explicitly distinguishes transaction control-flow evidence from native PostgreSQL rollback.
testReview: Independently executed seven actual-route cases. Asserted exact tenant/version expressions, transaction receiver scope, update/delete/insert order, insert and delete rejection without simulated commit, omitted and empty steps, missing parent and validation-before-transaction. Uses explicit ORM/auth/parser doubles, real response helpers; no SQL or database rollback claim.
